rule_of_this_file: Written and pushed before any candidate is scored on development data. Nothing here changes after that except through a dated amendment appended to 'amendments', made before the scores it can affect.
owner_steering: 2026-10-18 06:50Z: do all four workstreams, PRs and issues, auto-merge, issues left open; 'we need it to run on a ps vita, so smaller == better'
harness_note: eval/translucent_box.py may gain report and protected-set commands after the freeze; the classifier, the cohorts (the tag rows' sha256 below) and the score path do not change

candidate.name: split
api: vocr_split_lines(im, flags, arena, bytes, set, rows_read)
vocr_split_lines_rows(src, flags, arena, bytes, set, rows_read)
candidate.where: after the GRAD finder (runtime/vocr_lines.c, unchanged), before the refinement (runtime/vocr_lines_refine.c, unchanged); reads each box's own pixels only
candidate.off: flags 0 returns the finder's set unchanged and reads nothing (bit-identical; tested)
candidate.arena: vocr_split_arena_bytes(w, h) = 3 + up4(3w) + 3 up4(2h) <= vocr_lines_arena_bytes(w, h) (tested on a grid of sizes)
candidate.method: synth/lines_split.py's docstring (the twin is the specification): per GRAD box of at least 16 rows, bright and dark ridges along the rows (reach 3 px), S(y) = min(#bright, #dark) above 2/5 of their 99th percentiles (floor 24), valley segmentation (S[y] * 3 <= the smaller neighbouring peak), bands (S * 4 >= the segment's peak), text bands (>= 70% of the tallest, >= 10% of the heaviest mass, >= 6 rows), a continuity guard on the horizontal 3-pixel contrast (the gap's smallest count <= 60% of the bands' upper median), lines = band +- 16%, the box's columns and dark flag
candidate.design: chosen on training data only (eval/translucent_box.py design: realplus and teacher training frames, every reserved VN, every wd frame and every linefind screenshot left out; the sets below); the record is eval/translucent_box_design_20261018.json

development.wd: VOCR5's development whole dialogue, unchanged (eval/textdet.wd_units: tv_dlg plus the dn_dlg frames tv_dlg does not hold, base / +4 / +8 px; VOCR5's cohorts, sha256 below); every crop a mode returns read in order by the C runtime in W8I, joined, scored by transcript_score (dialogue text)
development.translucent_box_cohort: the wd units whose base region the frozen classifier tags (eval/translucent_box.py busyness >= 0.03, sample >= 48 px; the tags as committed in eval/translucent_box_prevalence_20261018.json and the private rows file below)
development.native_vita: #97's native-Vita subset (eval/textdet.native_vita_shots: teacher_val frames read as kind 'vita' and devnative's Vita frames)
development.baseline: #97's frozen baseline units (GRAD flags 0 / refine 31; $HERD/shared/artifacts/textdet/baseline/wd): this run's grad and refine units must equal them unit for unit

bootstrap.method: eval/textdet.vn_diff: VN clusters resampled with numpy default_rng(0).integers, 2.5 / 97.5 percentiles, variants pooled

adopted_iff: A. translucent-box cohort: split_refine - refine has a VN-cluster 95% interval entirely below 0, for each of VOCR5-S, -N and -L
B. rest of dev: split_refine - refine has no interval entirely above 0, for each model
C. native Vita: neither split_refine - refine nor split - grad has an interval entirely above 0, for any model
D. the C driver equals the twins on every development case in all four modes

E. cost: VitaSDK Thumb-2 text of vocr_lines_split.o at -Os <= 4,096 B; deepest stack frame (-fstack-usage) <= 4,096 B; the arena bound above; an estimated <= 25 ms per 900x150 box at 333 MHz on one Cortex-A9 core (the A9 cycle model, calibrated as #97 to VOCR3-H15's 5.0-5.2 ms per CTC frame)
rule.rubi_default: if adopted: Rubi runs the split in every game (its own setting, default on) when, for each model, also F. tagged: split - grad has an interval entirely below 0 and G. rest of dev: split - grad has no interval entirely above 0 (Rubi's Vita games run no refinement by default); otherwise the split runs only where the refinement does (Rubi's ocr_refine_lines, PSP games by default)
rule.not_adopted: the verdict is negative; a fallback (#97's detector gated on boxes the classifier tags, or the textgate model) may be tried only through a dated amendment made before any of its scores; the protected sets are read once for the candidate, labelled not adopted
report_only: #97's det+refine (s8_c24_seed4, its stored units) on the same cohorts
the owner's frames (own_dlg; seen during design as a no-false-split check)

protected.when: once, after the development record (scores, rule outcome) is committed and pushed
sets: vita-test + psp-test whole dialogue: eval's regions (a region with an uncertain line left out whole), base / +4 / +8, the four modes, each VOCR5 model; body text and all text; VN-cluster intervals (eval/finder_tighten's protected procedure with the split's modes)

CLANNAD long run: owner-drive-ingest's frozen references (refs_sha256 35411688...), each page's ROI, the C finder; a reference line reads every line derived from its GRAD box (the split, then the refinement), joined in order (eval/finder_tighten's clannad procedure); dialogue (no name style) and all lines; whole-page bootstraps
protected.attempts: attempt records created exclusively; a second run refuses

disclosures: The failure modes were diagnosed on development regions before this freeze, by viewing (GRAD and GRAD + refine boxes of v27449's four frames and of the 24 highest-error base regions, and the classifier's ranked samples); the classifier's statistic and threshold were chosen while viewing development regions. No candidate split was run on a development case before this freeze.
During design the prototypes were also run on the owner's frames (finder-tighten's own_dlg cohort, training data) as a check for false splits on native console text; it is report only here.
estimates: every console time is a host estimate (vita/a9_cycles.py's model under qemu-arm, as #83 and #97), labelled as such; nothing runs on a console (hardware work is paused by the owner)
